class Widget {
  render?(): string;
  static create?(): Widget;
  describe?(): string {
    return "widget";
  }
}
class Button extends Widget {
  render(): string {
    return "<button>";
  }
}
const plain = new Widget();
const button = new Button();
console.log(plain.render ? plain.render() : "no render");
console.log(button.render?.() ?? "no render");
console.log(plain.describe?.());
console.log(typeof Widget.create);
console.log(Object.getOwnPropertyNames(Widget.prototype).join(","));
